SCE.S:59008:
...You find yourself thinking:
"This place is like the bottom
of a deep sea."
And little by little, you rise
out of the sea of unconscious.
...You were born in the City.
When you were young, the City
was full of life. But one day,
the City suddenly changed, and
after high school, you left it.
After university, you became a
reporter for a local paper.
...Decades passed, and now you
have returned to the City of
your youth. ...You come to.
5 a.m., after an all-nighter
with your young assistant.
This day will be remembered
as the day it all began.
